title: Ruhullah Joins Students’ Protest, Calls Recruitment Corruption ‘Worse Than Murder’

ai.summary: Former MP Agha Syed Ruhullah Mehdi joined Kashmiri students protesting recruitment corruption, calling it 'worse than murder' and demanding accountability for irregularities that ruin youth careers.

facts.claim: Former MP Agha Syed Ruhullah Mehdi joined protesting students at Sher-e-Kashmir Park in Srinagar
facts.quote: Srinagar- Former Member of Parliament Agha Syed Ruhullah Mehdi on Saturday joined protesting students at Sher-e-Kashmir Park in Srinagar, describing recruitment corruption as “worse than murder” and demanding strict action against those responsible for alleged irregularities.

facts.claim: He described recruitment corruption as 'worse than murder'
facts.quote: describing recruitment corruption as “worse than murder”

facts.claim: He demanded strict action against those responsible for alleged irregularities
facts.quote: demanding strict action against those responsible for alleged irregularities.

facts.claim: He said the students are not joining with him, he is joining with the students
facts.quote: The students are not joining with me. I am joining with the students. I am not leading this,

facts.claim: He accused both governments of shifting responsibility onto each other
facts.quote: Both the administrations have confused us. They have made our children’s careers a football. They play football with each other,

facts.claim: He described recruitment irregularities as a grave injustice to deserving candidates
facts.quote: Describing recruitment irregularities as a grave injustice to deserving candidates,

facts.claim: He said the denial of merit-based opportunities was ruining careers
facts.quote: the denial of merit-based opportunities was ruining the careers of young people and undermining years of hard work.

facts.claim: He demanded accountability and stringent action against those involved
facts.quote: Those who are responsible for this, heads should roll,” he said, demanding accountability and stringent action against those involved.

facts.claim: He alleged a network developed over five to eight years to facilitate compromises
facts.quote: He further alleged that a network had developed over the past five to eight years to facilitate compromises and benefit certain individuals, claiming that the irregularities were deliberate rather than accidental.
